raw_response:
1. Even without a drawn 80% line, Qwen2.5-7b-1M is mostly above 80% across attributes, Internlm3-8b is mixed (some above, some below), ProLong-8b is mostly below except birthdate (above), and Qwen2.5-7b is far below 80% on all attributes.  

2. The figure shows ProLong-8b “birthdate” at roughly mid-80s (not ~60%), while “city” is around the high-60s; birthdate is therefore higher than city by about 15–20 points.  

3. The chart provides no error bars, confidence intervals, p-values, or test details, so statistical significance cannot be determined from the figure. With n=2 noted in the title, any apparent differences for “major” are likely unreliable without additional runs and uncertainty estimates.
